tournament.note: Each day every method picks its top 3 using only earlier races, relearns overnight, and is scored against the real result. Points: no.1 wins +2, +1 for each pick in the first three, +3 if all three are the first three. Days before the first live day are a replay: picked the same way, but after the races had been run.

method: Every number comes from past results only: a dog's rating never uses the race it is rated for.
The record is out of sample: each week of the last 922 races was predicted by a model trained only on earlier races.
Win chances add up to 100% in each race. Fair price = 1 / chance.
Bet only when a bookmaker offers clearly more than the fair price. Otherwise there is no edge.
warnings: The open data has no odds, so profit cannot be measured yet. The win rates show what odds you would need.
Bookmakers take about 15 to 20% on greyhound win markets. Most bettors lose over time.
